oracleRules.copiedHeal: The root/profile copy digests match before the public list; heal changes the profile auth digest while the root auth digest and root environment remain stable.
oracleRules.copiedUseAndReload: Require the expected initial/rotated model generation, no denial, and unchanged healed profile digest. Permit and record a root auth digest delta because root owns the selected grant.
oracleRules.copiedRefresh: Require rotated generation, a root auth digest change from the prior root snapshot, unchanged healed profile digest, and stable root environment.
oracleRules.independentGrant: Require added then added-rotated generations. Independent add and refresh preserve the root auth/environment; independent use/reload may record active profile metadata deltas while requiring the root to remain stable.
oracleRules.receiptBound: Mixed cases carry root/profile before/after auth digests, root environment after digest plus one unchanged boolean, and copy equality only on copied-lineage-heal. Duplicate profileCreate summary is suppressed. Existing V1 result and denial/equality assertions remain intact.
